newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-AJAX ENDS SEASON WITH BIG WIN, PSV STUMBLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AJAX ENDS SEASON WITH BIG WIN, PSV STUMBLE.

text.p: PSV Eindhoven, safe as Dutch league champions after last week's win over Willem ll, ended the season on a low note on Sunday, crashing 3-1 away to Roda JC.
Feyenoord, who fought PSV fiercely for the championship in the second half of the season, suffered the same fate, losing 2-1 away to 12th-placed Utrecht.
But PSV, perhaps still feeling the effects of last week's victory celebrations, can still savour their 14th Dutch title and their place in the European Champions' League next season.

Dick Advocaat, their manager, said his team clearly lacked concentration. "It was pretty simple. Roda had the will to make something happen and we didn't," he said. "The lads' batteries were pretty flat."

It was a different story for Ajax who finished the season with a thumping 4-0 win over Vitesse Arnhem, making up for some of the stumbling performances at the beginning of the season when injuries depleted the side.
Portugese striker Dani made the early running, blitzing Arnhem with a goal in the fourth minute. Barely two more minutes had passed before winger Marc Overmars made it 2-0.
The Amsterdam side, playing before a packed home crowd, turned on the style with another Dani goal in the 28th minute. Reuser rounded off the scoring in the 83rd minute.

Coach Louis van Gaal, who has steered Ajax to two Dutch championships, a European Cup win and the World Club Championship, bade the 49,000 crowd at the Arena an emotional farewell but kept mum about his destination next season.
Van Gaal, widely rumoured to be on his way to European Cup Winners' Cup victors Barcelona, is expected to keep an announcement under wraps until the end of the Spanish season in three weeks.
Ajax, last year's champions, also bid farewell to striker Patrick Kluivert and defender Winston Bogarde, who both move to AC Milan.
Feyenoord will see inspirational skipper Ronald Koeman and Gaston Taument leave. Koeman is retiring and Taument has signed a contract with Benfica of Portugal.
The Rotterdammers finished second in the league and also have a berth in the preliminary round of the European Champions Cup next year.
Third placed Twente Enschede, Ajax Amsterdam and Vitesse Arnhem will play the UEFA Cup next season. Roda JC who won the Dutch Cup, will play in the European Cupwinners' Cup.

At the bottom of the table, the curtains came down for AZ Alkmaar after only one season back in the top flight. They will be replaced by MVV Maastricht who on Saturday secured the second division title.
NEC Nijmegen and RKC Walwijk will play off with six second division sides for two places on the top flight of Dutch soccer.
